units.title: The Foundation
units.subtitle: Presence & Body Language
units.focus: Master physical presence, eye contact, and nervous system control.

lessons.title: The 3-Second Rule
lessons.concept: Holding eye contact builds trust and projects power. Breaking it downwards signals submissiveness.
lessons.drill: Introduce yourself to the camera while holding steady eye contact for 3-second blocks. When looking away, look to the side or up—never down.
lessons.quest: During your next 2 real-world interactions, hold eye contact for a full 3 seconds before naturally looking to the side.

lessons.title: Space & Posture Reset
lessons.concept: Occupying physical space lowers cortisol and increases felt confidence.
lessons.drill: Stand up facing the camera. Roll your shoulders back and down, feet shoulder-width apart, arms uncrossed at hips or sides. Hold for 60 seconds without fidgeting.
lessons.quest: Stand in an open posture in front of a mirror for 2 minutes straight without fidgeting or checking your phone.

lessons.title: The Presence Anchor
lessons.concept: Charisma requires 100% presence. If your mind is elsewhere, people sense it immediately.
lessons.drill: Deliver a 45-second response while staying physically grounded. During thinking pauses, keep gaze forward or neutral-horizontal—no wild side-to-side darting.
lessons.quest: In your next conversation, anytime you notice your focus drifting, perform a subtle physical grounding check (feet on floor) without breaking conversational flow.

boss.title: Unit 1 Boss Challenge
boss.label: Master Checkpoint
boss.challenge: Record a 60-second video of yourself introducing who you are while maintaining open posture and steady eye contact with the camera lens.

units.title: Vocal Power & Speech Control
units.subtitle: Breath, Fillers & Pace
units.focus: Eliminate filler words, master breathing, and lower your vocal pitch naturally.

lessons.title: Diaphragmatic Reset
lessons.concept: Shallow breathing raises vocal pitch and triggers anxiety. Deep abdominal breathing lowers pitch and adds resonance.
lessons.drill: 4-7-8 Technique: Inhale through your nose for 4 seconds (belly out), hold for 7 seconds, exhale slowly through your mouth for 8 seconds. Then speak a resonant phrase.
lessons.quest: Complete 3 full cycles of 4-7-8 breathing right before your next call, meeting, or conversation.

lessons.title: The Filler Word Purge
lessons.concept: Filler words come from a fear of silence. Replacing them with a pause signals composure and authority.
lessons.drill: Pick a random object nearby (e.g., a coffee cup). Speak continuously about it for 45 seconds out loud. Whenever you want to say "um" or "like," hit complete silence instead.
lessons.quest: Have one full conversation today where you use zero filler words, using quiet 1-second pauses instead.

lessons.title: The Slow-Mo Speech Drill
lessons.concept: Speaking too fast signals nervousness. Slowing down forces the listener to adapt to your cadence.
lessons.drill: Read any paragraph from an article out loud at half your normal speaking speed. Force a full 2-second pause at every comma and period.
lessons.quest: Deliver your next response in a real conversation at 75% of your standard speed.

lessons.title: Downward Inflection
lessons.concept: Ending sentences on a high pitch (upspeak) turns statements into questions. Pitching down at the end conveys confidence.
lessons.drill: Deliver three declarative statements (e.g. "We should proceed with this plan") with a firm downward pitch on the final word of each.
lessons.quest: End 3 declarative statements today with a clear downward pitch.

boss.title: Unit 2 Boss Challenge
boss.label: Master Checkpoint
boss.challenge: Record a 60-second audio clip explaining what you did yesterday.

passCriteria.label: Downward inflection on the final sentence

units.title: Dynamic Charisma & Social Impact
units.subtitle: Warmth, Timing & Presence
units.focus: Active listening, warmth-power balancing, and micro-rejection training.

lessons.title: The 1-Beat Pause
lessons.concept: Responding instantly makes you look eager. Waiting one beat shows you processed their thought.
lessons.drill: Answer 3 AI prompts. After each prompt ends, wait 1–2 seconds before you speak. Instant answers (<0.5s) count as rushed.
lessons.quest: Apply the 1-beat pause in at least 3 distinct interactions today.

lessons.title: The Warmth Balance
lessons.concept: Power without warmth is intimidating; warmth without power is easy to dismiss.
lessons.drill: Deliver a greeting to the camera combining a warm smile with open, grounded posture. Hold the combo for at least 5 seconds.
lessons.quest: Greet a coworker or stranger with a genuine smile while maintaining firm, open posture.

lessons.title: Comfort Zone Expansion
lessons.concept: Confidence expands when your fear of social risk decreases.
lessons.drill: Speak continuously to the camera. An AI heckler will interrupt mid-speech — keep steady gaze and calm pace (under 160 WPM).
lessons.quest: Perform 1 small micro-risk today and embrace the temporary discomfort.

lessons.title: The Reframe Engine
lessons.concept: Anxiety and excitement share identical physical markers (heart rate, adrenaline). Tell your brain it's excitement.
lessons.drill: Say "I am excited!" with high energy and open posture, then immediately deliver a ~30-second pitch with steady pacing.
lessons.quest: Use the excitement reframe before your next speech, meeting, or important call.

lessons.title: The Grand Synthesis
lessons.concept: Integrating presence, voice, warmth, and pacing into a seamless persona.
lessons.drill: Record a 2-minute pitch or story combining all skills: eye contact, low pitch, no fillers, open body language, and controlled pauses.
lessons.quest: Complete the Final Boss Challenge below.

boss.title: Unit 3 Final Boss Challenge
boss.label: Course Completion Test
boss.challenge: Record a 2-minute video sharing a personal story or explaining a topic you love.
